title: Malaysian Charred Chicken Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and aromatic stir fry dish featuring charred Malaysian chicken, served with a variety of vegetables.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the wok and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes. Remove from the wok and set aside.
In the same wok, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil and swirl to coat.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the wok and stir-fry until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the sliced red bell pepper and snow peas to the wok and stir-fry until the vegetables are tender-crisp, about 3-4 minutes.
Return the cooked chicken to the wok and stir in the Malaysian chili sauce, soy sauce, and fish sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, and stir-fry for another minute.
Transfer the stir-fry to a serving platter and serve immediately.
Optional: Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro or scallions, and serve with steamed rice or noodles.
